title: Ask the finance data
question: What do you want to know about revenue, cost and margin this quarter?
story: Genie answers from {rows} rows of the latest run across {accounts} accounts.
questions: What was the margin by region last quarter?
Which cost lines grew fastest this year?
Which customers paid late most often?
How does revenue this month compare with the same month last year?
Which products lost money after discounts?

datasets.name: ledger
datasets.sql: SELECT o.entity_id AS account, o.value AS amount, o.as_of_date, a.region, a.cost_center FROM main.finance.ledger_agent_out AS o JOIN main.finance.accounts AS a ON a.account_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'
